author: UltPanda
description: A One Piece Trading Card Game for Discord servers, similar to Pokecord
install_msg: Thanks for installing the One Piece TCG game! Use `.optcg` to get started. Make sure to enable the game with `.optcg enable` in the channel you want cards to spawn. If you encounter any issues, use `.optcg admin debug` to troubleshoot.
end_user_data_statement: Stores each user's Discord ID with their collected cards and starter claim status. Red data deletion requests remove this data.
